filterHelp: Enter IDs separated by commas or spaces. Empty filters include all permitted data.
auditRange: Enter a valid UTC period with the end after the start.
range: Enter a valid UTC period, up to 400 days, with the end after the start.
apply: Filters changed. Apply them to update results and export.
error: Request failed. Check the connection and submit again.
access: Access is unavailable. Previous data has been hidden.
offline: No network connection. Displayed data may be out of date.
sequenceError: Enter unsigned 64-bit sequence numbers in ascending order.
chainHelp: Checks the tenant chain by sequence, independently of search filters. Verification and export require global scope.
exportHelp: Export contains a fresh snapshot of the full tenant chain, marks matching records and includes hashes and signed checkpoints for independent verification.
reportHelp: Metrics use observation time; days use UTC. Zero duration may mean no observations. Export uses the applied filters and a fresh projection.
global: Global audit scope is required for verification and export.
chartHelp: Charts show at most 20 groups from the current table page. Exact values and all groups are available in the table and CSV.
downloadError: Export failed. No file was downloaded.
